content: Serve a Next.js static export from FastAPI: run 'next build' with output:'export' to produce out/, copy into the backend image, then app.mount('/', StaticFiles(directory='static', html=True)) after all /api routes are registered (mount order matters — API routes must be declared first or use more specific paths). For SPA client-side routing fallback to index.html on unknown paths, use a custom StaticFiles subclass or a catch-all route with FileResponse('static/index.html'). output:'export' disables headers/rewrites/redirects and i18n in next.config.js.
